profile.headline: Senior Mobile Engineer & Open Source Contributor
profile.summary: I am a software engineer, data scientist, and creative problem solver who delivers effective solutions through careful analysis and user focused design. With a background in software engineering and embedded systems, and a passion for audio and electronic design, I have worked with data ranging from music and speech to bio-metric and traffic. I believe that the best solutions are achieved by always designing for the customer. Utilizing modern software technologies, data analysis, and aesthetic design, I strive for excellent communication, reliability and user experience delivery.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developing SDKs and other tooling for the Solana Mobile Stack and larger Solana ecosystem

positions.title: Freelance Software Engineer and Open Source Contributer
positions.description:
Community Developer @Metaplex
Pushing the Solana Mobile ecosystem forward with open source kotlin libraries and dev tools

positions.title: DevEx Mobile Engineer
positions.description:
Built out mobile Kotlin SDKs for interacting with Metaplex (Solana) NFTs and on chain programs
Author of kBorsh Borsh serialization library, Metaplex Android, and JenIDL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for architecting new features and platform improvements, testing, and ongoing maintained of our native mobile apps and Node.js web app

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Built Android app that allows users to setup and control their Amazon Alexa enabled Atlantis Aquatics Smart Feeder (IoT fish feeder). Uses RESTful API and MQTT to store user data and interface with the fish feeder.

positions.title: Data Analyst/Graphic Designer
positions.description: Work with traffic engineer to analyze traffic data and generate traffic impact visualizations for various cities and real estate developers in Northern Colorado

positions.title: Producer/Creative Engineer
positions.description: Designer and Hardware/Software Engineer using light, sound and creative technology to create interactive installations that generate excitement, awareness, and engagement

positions.title: Software/Project Engineer
positions.description:
Software/Project Engineer at local start-up company specializing in bio-metric devices and brain-computer interfaces. Developed bio-metric monitoring systems in Java and C++, using RESTful APIs to store/retrieve data and send text message alerts

Contributed to the research and software development of VetMeasure's MeasureOn! bio-metric monitor harness for dogs

honors.title: Creative Works Awardee
honors.description:
- Awarded $12,000 to complete a Java library for sensory substitution applications
- Built an Android Library called "Tactile Waves" that provides a DSP toolbox and API for pre-processing, feature extraction, and classification of speech signals, as well as communication to sensory substitution hardware via Bluetooth

honors.title: Gadget Freak of the Year
honors.description:
- Led undergraduate mechatronics team through the design and production of a combination Attack Timer and Dynamometer to be used in any consumer vehicle
- Published in Design News Magazine September 2015 Issue
- Won Design New’s Gadget Freak of the Year 2015 – 1st place and $6000
honors.issuer: Issued by Design News Magazine · Sep 2015

publications.title: Development of a Sensory Substitution API
